newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX gasoline steepens losses late ahead of APIs.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX gasoline steepens losses late ahead of APIs.

text.p: NYMEX gasoline steepened losses in late session Tuesday amid position-squaring ahead of oil inventory data which was expected to show a bearish increase in gasoline stocks.
"My feeling is this is ahead of the APIs. Gasoline just continues to suffer, and crude failed technically at the $25.30 level, and was never able to recover," said a dealer.
At 1508 EST, February gasoline was off 0.99 cent at 67.10 cents a gallon while February crude was off nine cents at $25.10 a barrel. February heating oil was off 0.15 cent at 69.55 cents a gallon.
Tuesday evening, the American Petroleum Institute (API) is expected to report oil inventory data for the week ended January 10.
Traders estimates for the the build in gasoline stocks ranged from 800,000 barrels to four million barrels, with dealers citing weak demand behind the increase in inventory.
